Name: Pau
Description: The city of Hadar, who reigned over Edom after Baal-hanan's death, named in the Edomite king list of Genesis and Chronicles; his wife was Mehetabel, daughter of Matred, daughter of Mezahab.
BiblicalSignificance: Pau is one of the old Edomite capitals, a name carried by a king's reign in the days before Israel had a king.
